pages.name: Complaints are turning into specific fixes

elements.text: Complaints are turning into specific fixes
Four of the 13 “You said, We did” changes the report lists for 2023/24.

rows.text: Some customers reported a delay in receiving death certificates by post.
Death certificates are now sent by First Class post.
Healthy Lifestyle customers asked for appointments after 5pm.
Extended evening clinic hours are now available throughout the week.
Leisure customers receiving Personal Independence Payment asked for concessions.
The Concessionary Policy now includes customers receiving that payment.
Bowring Park parking information missed the newer car park by the tennis courts.
The website has been updated to reflect this information.
